officialPrimarySources.observation: Official directory lists the Maragha Office in Sohag.
Official Survey Authority describes its mapping and property-book remit.
Official page describes requesting/purchasing digital maps by location, layers, format, and projection; no anonymous parcel payload.
Official Government Printing Authority result for Ministry of Justice Decision 6911/2025 names Maragha City and Bani Hilal as Sohag cadastral sections subject to postponement.
Official public ArcGIS service metadata exposes Building, CITY, CENTER, STATE, and Equipments resources, not parcels.
